title: Stored source impact
responsibility: Stores compact revision snapshots and computes source impact between them without requiring a live repository.

inputs.name: storedSide.side
inputs.description: Impact-side snapshot containing tracked files, manifests, scenarios and dependency graph.

inputs.name: impactView.report
inputs.description: Computed impact report to reduce to history-facing source impact.

inputs.name: impactView.base
inputs.description: Compared-from commit, or null for the initial state.

inputs.name: sideImpact.base
inputs.description: Stored earlier commit/side, or null to represent the state before the first commit.

inputs.name: sideImpact.head
inputs.description: Stored later commit/side to compare against.

outputs.name: storedSide
outputs.description: Version 1 compact side with path/hash files, unit ownership, scenarios, node ids/kinds and numeric edge indexes. Edges with missing endpoints are omitted.

outputs.name: impactView
outputs.description: Source impact containing base, expansion, units, affected scenarios, uncertainty and changed paths.

outputs.name: sideImpact
outputs.description: Computed source impact using the normal ImpactService and TypeScript kernel against the supplied stored sides. No repository reads are required.
